desc: Ideate the core algorithm (Digit Contribution by Length Groups + DP).
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials for combinations.
Compute counts and sums of numbers by length.
Implement the DP function to compute the sum of powers of 10 for subsets of given sizes.
Compute the final answer by iterating over lengths.
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Ensure no runtime errors or TLE on large inputs.
